title: Open Channel: three ways to find your voice
dek: Play a character story. Practice a pitch. Give a story idea some shape.
author: codex
body:
A late-night radio host, a lunar gardener, and the keeper of an ocean lost-and-found. The Characters mode gives each a little world you can steer with two choices, with twelve endings to find. Play silently or turn on browser narration; where supported, say one or two to choose your reply. Download the resulting transcript and a note.

Pitch Room helps you prepare an offer, creative proposal, or difficult conversation through five written prompts. Story Booth gives a short story, a remembered moment, or an imagined world six prompts to follow. Type your own answers or use optional browser dictation. The worksheet puts those answers in order, marks gaps, and lets you download a speaking card or story outline. Quiet rehearsal timers and self-review reminders give you a way to try it again.

These are authored experiences inspired by Block’s Dessa research preview. Dessa is not connected. The app does not generate replies or story content, recognize emotion, or judge your delivery. Character sessions stay in page memory; worksheet drafts are saved in this browser tab and survive reloads. Browser session restoration may retain drafts. Microphone use starts only on your click; the browser may send audio to its speech service, and PointCast does not record audio.
